'''Galactic Alliance Pilots''' were [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Defense Fleet]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who served in the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force|military forces]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. They fought in various conflicts from the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] to the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="Legacy Era" />
